(a) The six-page list in #304's body is STALE: the pages whose helper reaches the stored-value arm are entities_metering, hot_water_tank, hot_water_pumps, grid_fees, solar_pv and away. async_step_learning declares the helper but never calls it; building, hot_water and grid are not on the live list. Derive the list from the tree. (b) The witness in tests/config_flow_steps.py is a PAIR per page: the stored default, and the null control that an unseeded page carries NO default. A registry attaching a default to every field passes the first and fails the second -- reproduce the two-armed behaviour, a default only when _current holds a truthy value for that key. (c) config_flow.py lands under the 100 pct bar: the residual statements are UNREACHABLE, so quality_scale.yaml config-flow-test-coverage is deliberately left todo by #304. Do not assume it flipped, and do not flip it without removing the dead code (#542). (d) #542: async_step_learning cleans CONF_EXTERNAL_HEAT_ENTITY to None on every save although its schema never presents that key (async_step_building does), and _save_or_menu merges, so saving that page destroys a configured entity. If the registry derives each page's write-set from the table this either disappears or is re-encoded, and the existing opt_learning check cannot tell you which: it seeds no options, so writing None over an empty dict is invisible. Control: with the key seeded, learning wipes it while heat_curve and tuning keep it. (e) Home Assistant section() stays refused, but only its SECOND reason survives: #520 raised the Home Assistant floor, voiding the version reason; tests/golden.py fingerprint walks schema.schema one level and does not recurse, so grouped fields leave the fixture entirely. Since this stage requires that golden byte-identical, grouping would satisfy 'no drift' by DROPPING fields -- legitimate only if fingerprint is taught to recurse first, in the same PR. (f) The hastub NumberSelector now validates on construction like real Home Assistant: mode defaults to slider and a slider missing either bound raises. A registry building number fields from a table must pass box mode or both bounds. It validates without rewriting the config, because fingerprint captures selector.config verbatim and injected defaults would move every option-page fixture.
